# Expiration Requirements Quality Checklist: Expire Unclaimed Room Reservations

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned checklist validating the clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability of requirements for expiring unattended reservations.
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the exact temporal threshold for transitioning an unattended reservation from `RESERVED` to `EXPIRED` unambiguously defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 - Does the specification explicitly define whether reservations in `ACTIVE`, `COMPLETED`, or `CANCELLED` status can ever be expired by the background process? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the state transition side-effects on room availability and conflict detection explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Invariants]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the system behavior specified for reservations that became overdue during application downtime or maintenance restarts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK005 - Is the background evaluation frequency and maximum expiration delay quantified with an objective, testable threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK006 - Are the exact error responses and status codes defined when attempting to activate an already expired reservation? [Clarity, Contracts §/activate]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the check-in grace period specified with an exact duration and standard unit rather than ambiguous terminology like "a short delay"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency & Invariants

- [x] CHK008 - Do the lifecycle state transitions in the feature specification perfectly match the existing domain entity status enum without introducing conflicting intermediate states? [Consistency, Data Model §Reservation, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the immutability of terminal states (`EXPIRED`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`) consistently enforced across all operational actions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §Invariants]
- [x] CHK010 - Do the conflict detection rules consistently align between manual expiration and automated background expiration? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Summary]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK011 - Does the specification define expected behavior when a reservation's total scheduled duration is shorter than or equal to the 5-minute grace period? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 - Are concurrency resolution expectations explicitly documented for race conditions where check-in and auto-expiration occur simultaneously? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §Decision 4]
- [x] CHK013 - Does the specification explicitly define whether a successful check-in prior to or within the grace period exempts a booking from subsequent auto-expiration? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]

## Operational & Non-Functional Quality

- [x] CHK014 - Are audit logging requirements specified with explicit field expectations (timestamps, IDs, counts) without leaking personal data? [Observability, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §IV, V]
- [x] CHK015 - Is an operational or automated verification mechanism documented for validating the sweep without requiring 5-minute wall-clock delays? [Testability, Quickstart §2, Contracts §/expire-unattended]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked (`[ ]`) when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
